summary: Gives worked examples of how win_command splits quoted and escaped arguments into argv, including paths with spaces and escaped backslashes, and notes how YAML/Ansible parsing requires raw tags for a backslash before a quote.
questions: How do I quote a program path with spaces in win_command?
Can you show how win_command arguments end up in argv?
How do I write a trailing backslash before a closing quote in win_command?

answer_card.title: win_command quoting examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```
- win_command: C:\temp\executable.exe argument1 "argument 2" "C:\path\with space" "double \"quoted\""
argv[1] = argument1
argv[2] = argument 2
argv[3] = C:\path\with space
argv[4] = double "quoted"
```

Quote an executable path with spaces: `'"C:\Program Files\Program\program.exe" ...'`.

Because of YAML and Ansible parsing, a `\\"` sequence must be written as `{% raw %}\\{% endraw %}"`.
